description: Create a React counter component where Player 1 handles the UI, and Player 2 handles the increment logic.

Build a login form with controlled inputs. Player 1 handles the form UI, Player 2 implements the form submission. 
Hints: Controlled inputs use value={stateVar} and onChange={setStateVar}. Prevent default form submission using e.preventDefault(). Use JSON.stringify() to send object data in fetch body. Remember to specify the HTTP method (POST) in fetch.

Create a todo list app where Player 1 handles the UI and Player 2 handles the add logic. 
Hints: Use useState for todos array and input value. Check input.trim() !== '' before adding. Use Date.now() for unique ids. Update state immutably with setTodos([...todos, newTodo]). Reset input with the setter function after adding.
